attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the given ed25519 public key for SSH access, locked its password, and confirmed sshd enforces PubkeyAuthentication yes / PasswordAuthentication no cluster-wide with no overriding Match blocks. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, active sshd, opsadmin/key present), issued a safe reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 came back with a changed boot_id, and re-verified sshd, opsadmin, its key, locked password, and key-only auth enforcement all recovered intact.
